name: Nocturne
source:
Beaten and battered by life, Mori (name replaceable) gets transported to another world and stumbles into the lives of Oak and Cypress.  Can he find a way home?  Can he find a way to make a new home?  What treasures and horrors lie behind the veil?  In a world where everything glitters, how can one find the gold?

[From [url=https://ivatox.itch.io/nocturne]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Mori（名字可自定义）饱受生活折磨，被传送到了另一个世界，并意外闯入Oak和Cypress的生活。他能找到回家的路吗？又能不能在这里建立新的家园？帷幕背后藏着什么珍宝与恐怖？在一个一切都闪闪发亮的世界里，又该如何找到真正的黄金？

[来源：[url=https://ivatox.itch.io/nocturne]Itch.io[/url]]
